This is basically how it was handled last year, except they are splitting Deal Team and Portfolio Ops. Regarding Analysts – we need to provide them the bonus targets rather than the Investment Committee just deciding. Regarding non-commercial roles – again, we need to provide the targets (as we discussed earlier this week).

The biggest issue we have is how to use the Cedar Point Capital workflow system and avoid the manual spreadsheet-system-spreadsheet exercise we went through last year. We are working with Hannah Ferguson and the Tech team on this.

VPs have to go through the final firm-wide Charlotte review, so that is one more step for the VPs, and the Deal Review Committee meeting outcome should be consistent with how all are rated going into the final meeting (i.e., 10/80/10, 1-100).

Jennifer
</body>

Here is our plan on Charlotte compensation.

Analysts:

Ranked 1,2,3 by supervisors - pay determined by Me and Brandy. No meetings.

Non Commercial but in New York:

Traditional ranking with the correct people attending the meetings. Pay grid determined by Investment Committee.

Associates and Senior Associates

Ranked as per Cameron Lemmons %'s and then pay grid determined by Investment Committee
I would like to see 25% - 65% - 10%. Cameron disagrees. This would provide for a quick meeting rather than trying to split them into 4 groups with the top one excluding some awesome people.

Managers/Directors

Ranked from 1 to 100 in as many clusters as the groups see fit. We are going to combine managers and directors into one table. The ranking is based on this year's performance is directly related to pay. We will have two meetings - one for Deal Team and one for other commercial staff (Portfolio Ops/Investor Relations/etc). We will not have a pay review committee but will take the results of the rankings and work with individual leaders after the meetings to ensure the appropriate compensation.

We will also determine promotions during this meeting using different criteria.

VPs

We will rank all our VPs from 1 to 100 with a group of selected people - some VPs and some MDs.
This too will be directly related to pay.

Cheers as you Brits say
